channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: What the Iran war has done to the world’s energy supply, in charts
item.description: Fossil fuels produce 81 percent of global energy. We look at Middle East’s role and what happens when supplies are cut.

item.title: US bombs cargo vessel in Gulf of Oman ‘trying to run Iran blockade’
item.description: A US fighter jet bombed a commercial cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman, according to CENTCOM.

item.title: Hurricane Isaias kills four, leaves 650,000 without power in Florida
item.description: Hurricane Isaias has killed four people and left more than 650,000 people without power.

item.title: Taiz hospitals near collapse as Houthis tighten siege: Yemen government
item.description: Medical services in Taiz risk shutting down as fuel, medicines, and supplies run alarmingly low under Houthi blockade.

item.title: US forces disable ship ‘attempting to run’ Iran blockade in Gulf of Oman
item.description: US military jet strikes stern of commercial cargo ship 'without harming the crew', CENTCOM says.

item.title: World condemns deadly Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh airport
item.description: Trump denounces 'terrible' attack and says the US is evaluating whether to join Saudi Arabia's offensive on the Houthis.

item.title: Trump ‘may’ join Saudi strikes on Houthis after Riyadh airport attack
item.description: President Donald Trump says the US ‘may’ join Saudi strikes against Yemen’s Houthis.

item.title: Twelve killed, more than 300 injured in Riyadh airport attack
item.description: Saudi Arabia has confirmed at least 12 people were killed and more than 300 injured after Houthi fighters struck Riyadh.

item.title: Iran war live: 12 killed in Riyadh, Saudi-led coalition vows to respond
item.description: As strikes on airports in Saudi Arabia turn deadly, Washington debates striking Houthis and restarting strikes on Iran.

item.title: Yemeni government’s military says its forces advancing against Houthis
item.description: Saudi-backed forces say 1,150 Houthis killed in operations against the Iran-aligned group over the past 24 hours.
